description: Get invoices the user has raised, with summary stats on outstanding and overdue amounts. Use when user asks about invoices, outstanding payments, or money owed to them.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

status.description: Filter by status: outstanding (every unpaid invoice), overdue (unpaid and past due), draft, sent, paid, cancelled, all

name: get_invoices
title: Get Invoices
